name: 33463 · Lake Worth, FL
findings: ZIP 33463 (Lake Worth) has 168 nonprofit organizations. 56 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (46% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33463 (Lake Worth) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
